correctness.rationale: Freezing the root at opinion one until its first reversal and thinning its independent rate-one update clock by arm gives independent rate-1/k kill hazards while the first arm vertex is zero. Each frozen path has a unique prefix of ones and a one-dimensional interface J, with 0→1 rate 1/2 for r>=2, interior ±1 rates 1/2, r−1→r rate 1. The harmonic probability of absorption at r before a return to J=0 starting at 1 is 2/(2r−1), including endpoint reflecting-rate equation. Therefore the sum of geometric repeated exponential residence times at J=0 is Exp(rate 1/(2r−1)), and its Laplace transform at 1/k is k/(k+2r−1). Independence over arms proves product and ties no-reversal precisely to all-one absorption. The degree-weighted spin fraction is a martingale under vertex updates, giving fixation k/(2L); these observables differ. Strict concavity of log(k+2r−1) yields balanced integer arm lengths as unique minimizer (up to permutation) and one long arm plus ones as maximizer. r=1 and k=1 boundary separately checked. Independent exact full-state CTMC killed-generator rational solution matched (r_i)=(1),(1,1),(1,2),(2,2),(1,1,2), confirming probability 1/2,4/9,4/15,4/25,9/32, without being treated as an infinite proof.
residual_risks: The frozen-center local-time derivation proves exact all-r result; only five finite CTMC examples were independently tested.
No claim for edge-update dynamics, general graph motifs or arbitrary initial states.

originality.rationale: PASS best-of-knowledge. Ben-Naim/Frachebourg/Krapivsky 1995 study voter persistence and flip-count distributions for Euclidean lattices and mean-field systems, not the rooted spider all-arm-length no-reversal probability. Sood–Redner 2005 study fixation and consensus time, not the stricter event of a given hub never flipping. A published exact product/resolvent result for private-CLIQUE bouquets has the same root-no-flip observable but fundamentally different blade transition generators and weights: it does not specialize to length-r rooted paths except the star r=1. No known same-object source was found giving the sharp arm-balancing extremals.
residual_risks: Unindexed stochastic-process literature might include this exact spider no-flip product; public search does not establish absence.
Difference between rate-one per-vertex and per-edge copying conventions is material and preserved.

value.rationale: PASS: separating hub never-flip persistence from its classical fixation probability on nonregular trees is a motivated stochastic process question. The exact independent-arm local-time factorization yields a natural, sharp quantitative topology effect: at fixed total edges and center degree, balancing arm lengths uniquely minimizes the leadership survival probability while concentrating length maximizes it, despite identical fixation chance. The unequal large-system limits give mathematically substantive shape sensitivity.
residual_risks: Fixed L and k only, not a claim for arbitrary attached motifs or arbitrary initial density.

limitations: Center initially sole opinion-one vertex; rate-one individual vertex Poisson clocks, uniform neighbor copying.
